evaluation.label: Not generally

issues.description: S1 states the consolidated net profit for Q2 2026 was EUR 24.7 million, while S5 states the consolidated net income for Q2 2026 was EUR 79.0 million. These figures represent fundamentally different metrics (net profit vs. net income) without clarification, creating an internal contradiction about the primary profitability metric for the period.

evaluation.justification: The summary contains a significant self-contradiction between S1 (consolidated net profit of EUR 24.7 million) and S5 (consolidated net income of EUR 79.0 million) for Q2 2026. These are presented as distinct figures without explanation, implying they are both measures of the same underlying performance metric. This creates confusion about which figure represents the Group's actual profitability. While other relationships between figures (e.g., quarter-on-quarter changes) are logically presented, this fundamental contradiction undermines the overall coherence of the summary. The remaining sentences show generally logical relationships and organization, but the contradiction is severe enough to warrant a 'Not generally' rating.
